description: Call when the user has 2-4 candidate locations and asks which is best for a data center. Pass locations as "lat,lon;lat,lon" and optional capacity_mw. Returns each site's analyze_site scores side by side plus a recommended winner and why. Keyless returns each site's verdict band and power band, with the other factors named; a free key adds names and counts without figures; scores and figures need a paid DC Hub plan, as does the pick. Ex: "Phoenix vs Ashburn for 50 MW?"

capacity_mw.description: Target power load for the build in megawatts (MW), e.g. 50 (typical 50-500)

locations.description: Semicolon-separated list of 2-4 "lat,lon" pairs to compare, e.g. "33.45,-112.07;39.04,-77.48"

mpp_credential.description: Stripe MPP step 2: the Shared Payment Token minted for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call.

mpp_pay.description: Stripe MPP step 1: true returns a signed per-call payment challenge (a quote; no money moves) instead of the free preview. Agents only.

sites.description: Alternative to locations: an array of {lat, lon} (or {lat, lng}) objects, 2-4 sites

name: compare_sites
title: Compare Sites
